The punktfunk streaming CLIENT on the CachyOS base — punktfunk-client and its headless CLI, plus the punktfunk verb plugin so a bed can drive the client in charly verbs. No compositor: the headless CLI needs no display server, which is the whole reason a client venue stays a plain container.

## Composition

This box composes:

- `@github.com/opencharly/layer-punktfunk-client:v2026.272.0448`

- `@github.com/opencharly/pod-pipewire:v2026.273.1856`
